description: The profit and the profit margin percentage from revenue and total costs (margin = (revenue - costs) / revenue x 100). A negative margin is a valid result. Use for questions about profit as a share of sales, from two figures for the same period. Do not use for return on money invested (use smartfin_calculate_roi), for taxes, or to say whether a margin is good: the tool reports the figure only. The cost figure is whatever the user supplies, so it says nothing about gross versus net unless they define it.

currency.description: Currency symbol for the amounts in the summary only; amounts are never converted. The link opens the page in US dollars, and how_to says to pick the currency there. Default USD

revenue.description: Revenue for the period in the currency chosen, above 0

total_costs.description: Total costs for the same period in the currency chosen; it can be above revenue

name: smartfin_calculate_profit_margin
